notes.title: Demo Update - New Reactivity
notes.notes: [p][b]As promised a few weeks back, here is the demo update! This will be the last content update to the demo outside of bug fixes as we move all our focus to finishing up The Funnel for release.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Also, we'll be participating in October's Steam Next Fest! So keep an eye out for that.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Save Files:[/h3][p]In regards to saves, I would recommend deleting all your old demo saves and creating new ones with this update. Old saves might still work, but they could cause bugs and unfortunately we have to prioritize the full game over maintaining demo save cross version-compatibility.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]Patch Notes[/h1][list][*][p]The [spoiler]Ira heart attack[/spoiler] sequence now has six possible outcomes with more reactivity that takes into account things like the player assembly count, number of books read, and NPC trust levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dice minigame rolls occasionally recording the wrong number.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Processor VO to prepare for new dialogue SFX system.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Demo Version save checker (Will inform you if your demo saves are out of date).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved NPC obstacle avoidance (They've learnt how to step left instead of just right!).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading and I hope you enjoy the changes we've made to the demo. We always appreciate reviews, but if you have any feedback or bugs and want to contact me directly, you can do so here: [url="https://inquiries@bronzemanstudio.com"]inquiries@bronzemanstudio.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Next week we'll get to that last character dive for your third crew member: Ira.[/p][p]-Gabe[/p]

notes.title: Characters Of The Funnel
notes.notes: [p][b]This week we're part of the Hungry Ghost Festival 2025! Check out the page below for all sorts of mysterious and scary games.[/b][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621-South-East-Asia-Game-Aesthetic/sale/thehungryghostfestival2025" style="button"]Hungry Ghost Festival 2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Also, just a reminder to leave a review of our demo if you've tried it! Any feedback we get will help us improve the final game.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Today I wanted to give you an overview of the second of your three crew mates: Borus.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]WHO IS BORUS[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/bdae17051766a7e9c6425c50bc4381977ddb9474.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Borus was born on the surface, but within a few years his family moved into the factories. All he has left of the surface are blurred images and dreams. Borus might go along with the factory rules but he's pretty damn sure that no one's telling the truth around here. He might be suspicious of new faces, but if you gain Borus' trust, you'll have it for life. As long as you're not working for the Funnel...[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]THE MYSTERY OF THE FUNNEL[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/5dd4a46533eb7ff5beb43f68ee914e4e2b65cb0c.png"][/img][/p][p]If you end up befriending Borus, you might find yourself sneaking around the factory after hours and trying to uncover information that's not meant for your eyes. If one thing's for certain, it's that Borus won't rest till he's learnt what's really going on in this factory. After all, why don't they tell you where the assembly boxes go?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]ONE WAY OUT[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/01d80ec3d56698800a12857c854f923bcd694201.png"][/img][/p][p]There's only one ending to this whole thing as Borus sees it. Either he's getting out of this factory, or he'll die in the process. Will you join him?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]I hope you've enjoyed this dive into the second of the three crew mates that you will be working with in The Funnel. Next time we'll look at Ira and his life before the factories.[/p][p]-Gabe[/p]

notes.title: Characters Of The Funnel
notes.notes: [p][b]Three weeks ago we launched The Funnel - Demo. Thank you to everyone who's tried it so far! [/b][/p][p]We're working on a little update to expand the consequences of your actions in the demo so keep an eye out for that. If you have yet to try the demo, you can do so here:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180550/The_Funnel__Demo/"][/dynamiclink][b]If you have any thoughts, please leave a review![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Today I wanted to give you an overview of the first of your three crew mates: Mike.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]WHO IS MIKE[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/a7f6f4d19a97ea2ca07e9b1d825fb552e486d086.png"][/img][/p][p]Mike is the youngest of your three crew mates and one of the first people to be born in the underground factories. He's never known the surface world but he seems to be pretty happy about that. Some people may call him overly enthusiastic but even those people would have to admit that if you need to talk to someone, you won't find a kinder ear than Mike's. However, if you need to talk to someone about something that you think might go against the Funnel's guidelines, you may want to talk to someone else.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]REACHING FOR THE FUNNEL[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/15e0caaa3a0d95552c3a9b1f4b5171e08b2a1968.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you happen to connect with Mike over a shared interest in the Funnel and history of the factories, you may find yourself pouring over books to learn the Funnel's wisdom and working on new devices to improve life in the factories. When it comes to these things, no one is more dedicated than Mike. Unless you are...[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]BEYOND THE FACTORY[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/e74d03cdafe9cff87fa93eb721c6272fc9a9e126.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Working with Mike might even lead you to travelling beyond your factory and serving the Funnel in the most important of roles. But, I'll leave that for you to discover.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]I hope you've enjoyed this dive into the first of the three crew mates that you will be working with in The Funnel. Next time we'll look at Borus and his plan to escape the factory.[/p][p]-Gabe[/p]

notes.title: World Of The Funnel
notes.notes:
[p][b]Curious to see more gameplay of the Funnel? We have been releasing a series of shorts over the past month on our various social media pages. Check out our Youtube channel [/b][url="https://www.youtube.com/@bronzemanstudio"]here[/url][b].[/b][/p][p]Today we will be looking at the world of The Funnel and why in our alternate history did humanity move to the underground factories.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]A SURFACE LOST[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/80f85f51ceaabc05ccef08a64a24ac379085be44.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I would like to thank the Cultural Review for the honour of being asked to present you this brief overview of humanity's history. With the exciting and tragic prospect upon us, of the first humans being born without any experience of the surface world, I find the preservation of the human story to be more important than ever. [/p][p][/p][p]Let us begin with the foundational event of our new civilization: The Surface War. Over the course of the nineteenth century, the world raced down a path of amalgamation as our technological advancements demanded greater levels of global cooperation. Broadly speaking, this led to two major geopolitical shifts. In the west, there was the Unification Declaration between Europe and the Americas, and to the east came the wide-reaching Nippon Alliance. As the world shifted into a bipolar order, the scale of potential conflict only grew. When the Surface War finally did break out, it was the most horrific and all-encompassing event that any of us ever knew. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]OUR SAVIOUR: THE FUNNEL[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/1b30105946467eb51da51d0667148cda56cb1d51.png"][/img][/p][p]However, the same world order that led to our greatest failure, also consistently produced technological marvels that were beyond the reaches of our dreams. The pinnacle achievement of that great and terrible time was what the eleven scientists called the Collectivized Intelligence Device. Now, you will know this great work as the Funnel. The Funnel is a type of reasoning device which was created by processing every piece of human knowledge and intelligence to create one grand melting pot of the human will. [/p][p][/p][p]While the world began to tear itself part, the Funnel was wise enough to foresee where this destruction would lead. To safeguard humanity, the Funnel began the great excavation that led to the creation of over ten thousand underground factories.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]THE WORLD AHEAD[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/cad50e6b0214abe46f1f386f3465239bd373fe59.png"][/img][/p][p]Many of my readers often ask me why we cannot eventually move back to the surface and rebuild our lives there. After all, even if the environment has collapsed, surely our technological means which have enabled us to live underground, could also be applied to make a new life on the surface. To answer this, I will repeat a quote from my upcoming book [i]The World Ahead[/i]: [/p][p][/p][p]"the move underground was not only vital for our physical survival, it was vital for our existential survival. As the act of living underground condemns humanity to perpetually feel the guilt of the surface war, it also ensures that no matter how distant our generations become, they will all know in their hearts the cost of war, simply by looking at a painting of the surface."[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]K. Polowski[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We hope you’ve enjoyed this dive into some of The Funnel's alternate history. Keep an eye out in the coming weeks for some exciting news regarding [b]The Funnel - Demo[/b].[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Mechanics Of The Funnel
notes.notes:
[p][b]Two weeks ago we did our first deep dive into the mechanics of The Funnel. If you're curious to know more about how your choices will affect the world of The Funnel, check it out [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3164380/view/577137206083191667"]here[/url][b].[/b][/p][p]Today we will be exploring the assembly of gear boxes, the central minigame in the first act of The Funnel.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]YOUR GREAT WORK[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/fbb66b4fc438771a34bef984560a87b406fa5db7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Upon completing your transfer to Assembly Factory 4318, you will be assigned your new job. Every shift you must assemble six gear boxes. Every gear box has a start and end gear which you can see as the colored bronze gears above. By connecting the start and end gear, you complete a gear box. But such simple work alone would not befit someone of your abilities. Each gear box has numerous challenges such as red gear-halters that move around and stop you from being able to complete the box.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]BOOSTING YOUR MOTIVATION[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/fe87e91e56046d457ea8a43dcfdcd3d911625436.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Some days you may not feel like completing your required amount of gear boxes. Perhaps a crew mate is getting you down and you feel that today only four gear boxes will suffice. Do not worry as that is where your factory's CES unit comes in (pictured above). Every CES unit comes fully equipped with a motivational coil. If you attempt to leave your shift early or do not complete the required amount of assemblies in your set shift time, the CES unit will provide you with a motivational zap that will render you into a sleep-like state. After experiencing this motivational measure, you will awaken rested and bursting with enthusiasm to complete your required assemblies.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]WHY GEAR BOXES[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/03fd454c7c6bea291eb573483bf55079bc11932a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]So what are these gear boxes that you must assemble each day? The answer is that they are a part of a whole. In the great underground factory network of The Funnel, thousands of parts are created in thousands of different factories to fit together and create whatever is needed to keep humanity going. You would not expect yourself to be able to comprehend every single interaction between plants and animals in the surface world, and likewise you should not attempt to understand the great importance of every single factory in this grand network. Simply look to your crew mates, look to your assembly table, and continue your great work. Know that you are under the safety of the Funnel's guidance.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We hope you’ve enjoyed this dive into the great work you will be doing in The Funnel. Keep an eye out next for an exploration of: [b]The World Of The Funnel.[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Mechanics Of The Funnel
notes.notes:
[p][b]Two weeks ago we announced our studio’s debut game: The Funnel. If you have yet to see the announcement trailer, check it out [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164380/The_Funnel/"]here[/url][b].[/b][/p][p]The trailer is just a sample of the many elements in the Funnel, but we wanted to take this chance to dive deeper into the mechanics you can expect from our narrative puzzle system.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]DIALOGUE[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/0c75d6079dc2cc90e637ee2659e58a69e8aa8f5e.png"][/img][/p][p]At the heart of The Funnel is our dialogue system which I’m sure many of you will be familiar with as it mirrors many other branching dialogue systems. However, one thing that’s really important to us is making sure that every choice matters in some way. We’ve gone through multiple passes in our dialogue to make sure that every time you are offered a choice, you are either changing the course of your story or at the very least affecting an NPC’s overall opinion of you.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]IMPLICIT CHOICE[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/1e918a77f51f49327210a30f615e5a10e9af8425.png"][/img][/p][p]To add on to this, the concept of implicit choices is an important pillar of The Funnel. Narrative events will not only be affected by the explicit dialogue choices you make, but also any actions you take and whether they line up with what you said you would do. One of our character’s might ask you to meet at night and explore an abandoned part of the factory. But, if you don’t show up that night or even meet them only to turn around and leave, they might feel abandoned by you and decide to go explore the factory on their own.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]MINIGAMES[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629685/169ceaa8f7db2254b46edd7d002ebee4639bc422.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Another very important part of The Funnel’s choice structure is our minigames. Rather than having failures in a minigame result in a typical fail state and retry, our minigames treat success and failure as story paths. If you fail to unlock a door in time for example, it may lead to you being discovered and your factory being punished. There are no points in The Funnel where the game will ever ask you to reload.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We hope you’ve enjoyed this short exploration of the way choices operate in The Funnel. Keep an eye out next week for a dive into our central minigame: [b]The Gear Assembly.[/b][/p][p]
[/p]
